translated_text: Game 3 of the Eiou title, one of shogi's eight major titles, was held in Nagoya. Challenger Shintarō Saitō (8-dan) defeated the two-time defending champion Takumi Itō (Two-Crown), winning one game back and keeping alive his hopes of capturing a title for the first time in eight years. The best-of-five Eiou title match continues...
title_en: Shogi: Saitō (8-dan) Defeats Itō (Two-Crown) in Game 3 of Eiou Title Match
